For Fall and Spring semesters, locate your class meeting days and start time to find your final exam schedule.

Legend

M = Monday
T = Tuesday
W = Wednesday
R = Thursday
F = Friday
S = Saturday

MW = Monday & Wednesday
MWF = Monday, Wednesday & Friday
MTR = Monday, Tuesday & Thursday
MTWR = Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday
MTWRF = Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday & Friday
TR = Tuesday & Thursday
